chunks: Show mercy to those on the earth, and the One in the heaven will show mercy to you.

key_terms.اِرْحَمْ: Show mercy; a command to act with compassion
key_terms.مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ: The One in the heaven; referring to Allah, the Exalted
key_terms.مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ: Those on the earth; creation and people around you

ai.seo_question: How does showing mercy to people relate to receiving Allah’s mercy?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that showing mercy to creation is a means of receiving divine mercy. It links a believer’s conduct toward others with Allah’s mercy toward them, making compassion a central ethical virtue.
